recommendation: promote-candidate (conditional). KPH passes the screen bar (ALL +0.041 [0.010,0.073], no negative group) and adds a replicated, targeted router-theft defense on top of KP (+0.091 on the router spec) without hurting KP's zrl03/ah02/zchain4 steal (h8e7v vs 3xuy5 +0.027). But its field-S edge over KP (+0.012, n.s.) comes from cohorts where h34 has never replicated on fresh fields. Suggested: confirm KPH and KP on the same fresh salt (paired arms, more multi cohorts). Promote KPH only if pooled KPH-KP is not below about -0.005 and the multi gate passes; otherwise promote KP and keep h34 as a 1-byte router defense for later. Do not confirm h34 alone again. Domain 9 otherwise closed: no other self-harm fix has value above noise.
